days.file: Rembrandt Christ in the Storm on the Lake of Galilee.jpg
days.title: Christ in the Storm on the Sea of Galilee
days.alt: In a wind-torn boat on a stormy sea, the disciples struggle with the sail and rigging while Christ sits calmly among them.
days.look: Look again at the tossed boat and the One who is with them in it. What fear would you hand to Him tonight?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Master Of The Aix Annunciation - The Prophet Jeremiah - WGA14509.jpg
days.artist: Barthélemy d’Eyck (Master of the Aix Annunciation)
days.title: The Prophet Jeremiah
days.place: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium, Brussels
days.alt: The prophet Jeremiah, in a red robe and cap, stands in a painted niche reading an open blue book.
days.look: Look again at Jeremiah reading his book. Can you rest in God’s knowing of your child, before anyone else has seen their face?
days.license: Artist died c. 1476; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Visitation
days.alt: Mary in blue and Elizabeth in gold and white embrace under a stone arch, their foreheads nearly touching.
days.look: Look again at the two women holding each other. Who could you let come close and share your waiting?
days.license: Artist died 1515; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Anton Raphael Mengs - The Dream of St. Joseph - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Dream of St. Joseph
days.alt: St. Joseph rests his head on his hand, deep in thought, while an angel behind him points the way and speaks to him.
days.look: Look again at the angel’s hand pointing the way over Joseph’s head. What courage do you need to ask for?
days.license: Artist died 1779; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: El Greco - St. Paul - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: Saint Paul
days.alt: St. Paul, in a blue-green tunic and rose cloak, looks out gravely, holding a letter and the hilt of a sword.
days.look: Look again at the letter in Paul’s hand. What would you bring to God with thanks, before you ask?
days.license: Artist died 1614; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Cappella tornabuoni, 12, Nascita di san giovanni battista.jpg
days.title: The Birth of St. John the Baptist
days.place: Tornabuoni Chapel, Santa Maria Novella, Florence
days.alt: St. Elizabeth sits up in bed while women in long gowns tend the newborn and help care for her.
days.look: Look again at the women gathered around Elizabeth and her newborn. Who cares for mothers and babies that you could pray for by name?
days.license: Artist died 1494; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Georges de La Tour - The New-born - WGA12349.jpg
days.title: The New-born
days.alt: A mother in a red dress holds her swaddled newborn on her lap while a second woman looks on, her hand shielding a candle.
days.look: Look again at the mother’s hands holding her newborn. What would you ask of God for the hour your child is born?
days.license: Artist died 1652; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Christ in Gethsemane
days.alt: An angel in white holds Christ close as He kneels in sorrow, His head bowed against the angel.
days.look: Look again at the angel holding Christ in His sorrow. What sorrow will you let the Father hold tonight?
days.license: Artist died 1890; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Leonardo da Vinci - Annunciazione - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Annunciation
days.alt: Mary in blue sits beside a carved stone lectern in a garden, one hand raised and the other resting on an open book.
days.look: Look again at Mary’s raised hand. What would your own yes to God sound like today?
days.license: Artist died 1519; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
